dispositions.finding: 2. Independently assert both integer pool boundaries for all parsed integer leaves, incl. nested terms
dispositions.assessment: assert_integer_pool asserts value<20 implies canonical spelling, else membership in 20..80 AND non-canonical spelling, and recurses into Term::Triple objects. Applied to LOAD-document objects and to every post-update generated-state object across 400 seeds. CANONICAL_INTEGER_VALUES is pinned by assert_eq!(…,20) rather than used to derive the expectation, so the oracle no longer depends on the production constant nor on a sampled collision. Control partial-canonical-pool-overlap (rng.below(40)) → 101 is the correct discriminator for canonical/noncanonical overlap.
dispositions.residual_nonblocking: Integers occurring only in never-matching DELETE patterns are not asserted; a negative integer literal would panic at parse::<u64>() with a misleading message rather than a pool assertion. Both fail closed.
